project_name: Crypto Conex - Inclusive Remote Assistance Ecosystem & CRM
archetype: Swiss High-Contrast + Tactical Operator Command Center

theme_strategy.public_page: Ultra-Accessible Light/Dark High-Contrast Hybrid with massive visual targets, soft tactile depth, and maximum legibility for low tech literacy & motor impairment
theme_strategy.crm_dashboard: Tactical Dark Precision Command Console with high density, real-time WebRTC canvas streaming, accessibility tree visualization, and quick remote action control

font_rules: DO NOT use Inter or Arial for headlines. Use Outfit for clean geometry and impact.
Public Page: Use massive text sizes (H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl, Body: text-xl sm:text-2xl) for maximum readability by elderly or vision-impaired users.
CRM Dashboard: Use dense typography hierarchy (Headers: text-xl to text-2xl bold, Body: text-sm, Metrics: font-mono text-xs to text-sm) to maximize information density.
Always set tracking-tight on display headings and line-height leading-snug for multi-line instructions.

rules: Strict compliance with WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast ratios (minimum 7:1 for public connection page elements).
Never rely on color alone for status indicators; pair colors with icons and clear text labels (e.g. Live Badge = pulse animation + green color + text 'AO VIVO').
Never use pure black #000000; use #0B0F17 for dark background and #0F172A for light text.

public_connection_page.structure: Single-focused vertical container, centered alignment with zero clutter. Screen space dedicated 60% to the primary 'Conectar' action button.

hero_button.micro_interaction: Active press animation with scale-95 and clear visual/audio state 'Conectando...', 'Conectado'.

secondary_button.style: h-16 w-full max-w-md text-lg font-bold border-2 rounded-2xl bg-white text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100

accessibility_features: Audio feedback voice synthesis trigger option
Large 6-digit session pin generator with visual click-to-copy

crm_web_dashboard.grid_columns: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 min-h-screen bg-[#0B0F17]

components.sidebar_queue: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 bg-[#111827] border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-2rem)]
components.main_stream_viewer: col-span-12 lg:col-span-6 bg-[#111827] border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-2rem)] relative overflow-hidden
components.control_and_tree_panel: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 bg-[#111827] border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-2rem)] gap-4 overflow-y-auto

1_public_connection_page: Header with Crypto Conex logo, accessibility options (font size boost, high contrast toggle, sound instructions).
Central Hero Card containing status banner ('Pronto para conectar'), Session Code display, giant 'CONECTAR AGORA' button (WebRTC screen share trigger).
Sub-hero section with 'Baixar Aplicativo Assistente' (Android APK & Windows EXE links).
Help/Support modal with step-by-step visual illustrations.
2_crm_login_and_auth: JWT Login with Role detection (Super Admin vs Technician).
Super Admin sees full system overview, metrics, technician availability, global unassigned queue, manual assignment controls.
Technician view filters automatically to assigned active sessions + global queue pull action.
3_global_queue_panel: Real-time list of pending help requests with priority indicators, user OS icon (Android/Windows/Web), user initial/code, wait time.
Filter by status: Unassigned, Assigned to me, In Progress, Resolved.
'Atribuir a Mim' action button with immediate status transition.
4_webrtc_live_stream_viewer: Canvas-based stream container with real-time screen display.
Interactive overlay overlaying mouse coordinates and remote tap/click/swipe injection.
Toolbar overlay: Screenshot, Pause stream, Quality selector (HD/SD), Latency indicator (ms), Record session button.
5_remote_interaction_command_console: Action buttons: Single Click, Double Click, Long Press, Swipe Up/Down/Left/Right, Back Button, Home Button, Type Text Input.
Macro shortcuts for quick assistance (e.g. Open Settings, Highlight Element, Guide Pointer).
6_accessibility_node_tree_reader: Structured tree view of the user device screen's accessibility DOM / Android Accessibility Nodes.
Highlightable nodes: Text labels, Clickable elements, Input fields, Focus hierarchy.
Clicking a node in the tree sends target action straight to that element on the user's remote device.
7_session_history_and_logs: Detailed session log drawer/tab with timestamps of connection, commands sent, technician notes, duration, and resolution status.

rules: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease) - NEVER transition: all.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all public page visual effects.
CRM Stream canvas must update smoothly with minimal render lag.
Micro-animations on remote command dispatch (visual pulse on remote screen click indicator).

accessibility_and_usability_standards.wcag: AAA standards for public assist page, AA for CRM dashboard
accessibility_and_usability_standards.touch_targets: Minimum 56px for standard controls, 80px+ for main Public 'Conectar' button
accessibility_and_usability_standards.screen_readers: Aria-live regions for session state updates ('Conexão iniciada', 'Técnico conectado')
accessibility_and_usability_standards.keyboard_nav: Full tab navigation support and visible high-contrast focus rings

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact component guidelines provided in this file.

Ensure both surfaces (Public Connection Page & CRM Operator Portal) are fully implemented and accessible via client-side router (/ for public page, /login for CRM login, /crm for technician dashboard).
For the public page, keep the design ultra-clean, friendly, high contrast, bold text, large icons, and straightforward instructions.
For the CRM dashboard, provide real-time mock simulation for WebRTC stream, command logs, queue updates, and accessibility node hierarchy tree.
Integrate Sonner toasts for connection alerts, technician assignment feedback, and action confirmations.
Add proper data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
